title: Focused Operating Principles
excerpt: The eight operating principles that shape how Focused works with clients and with each other. Written by our engineers, for our engineers.
content_html:
Our operating principles define how we approach every interaction with our clients and each other. They serve as the foundation for our culture and guide the way we collaborate, problem-solve, and deliver exceptional outcomes.

“Culture eats strategy for breakfast.”

Often attributed to Peter Drucker

/Who we are

/How we work

/Where these came from

Written by our engineers, for our engineers.

A few of our senior engineers wrote these while we were hiring fast. They were training and onboarding new people, and wanted to write down how we show up on an engagement so new folks could pick it up quickly.

They sit next to our values: love your craft, listen first, learn why. The values came from our first few employees. The operating principles are more tactical. They describe how we work with clients, day to day.

Read our values

/Part 01

Who we are

Our clients face many challenges and we relentlessly cut distractions to align on specific outcomes. We are engaged, resolute, inquisitive, and guide alignment with stakeholders and business goals. We seek to tie micro efforts to macro context.

We emanate care for delivering quality because we master our craft. We share our enthusiasm for delivering quality software with everyone around us. We grow our spheres of influence without the need for authority.

/03

Unintimidating

#Copy link

We are experts and welcome clients to share their challenges with us. We believe a positive experience for our clients requires technical expertise and delivering exceptional service. We are inclusive and open to diverse opinions.

/04

Radically candid

#Copy link

We respect our clients’ processes, culture, and ways of working while pushing them towards better ones. We understand the “why” behind their workflows and collaborate in a way that helps build strong partnerships and deliver exceptional results.

/Part 02

How we work

/05

Trusted advisors

#Copy link

Our success is our client’s success. We seek to build trust and influence for mutual gain without authority or compromising our values. We leave our clients in a better place than when we started. We bring clients on our journey and build with them. A project is only successful when it ends with a warm goodbye.

/06

Meet clients where they are

#Copy link

We understand the current state, needs, and preferences of our clients. We adapt our consulting approach to align with the client’s resources, goals, and existing systems or processes. We seek to positively disrupt our clients and introduce pragmatic change.

/07

Create predictable change

#Copy link

Software is notoriously hard to estimate and our processes seek to build confidence in delivery. Software testing, user interviews, demos, and data-driven decision making are just a few ways that we pursue and operate on feedback to create predictability in change. We refine our processes through iteration and speak openly about risks, setbacks, and misses.

/08

Urgency and intention

#Copy link

We are committed to making the most of our client’s time. We have a bias for action and persist to ensure that every minute spent with us is purposeful and contributes to client goals.
